question: Why did the error rate go up on 03 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of catalog v4.7 introduced a NullPointerException.
why_chain: v4.7 deployment caused the error rate to rise.
NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.7) triggered the error.
The error rate increase is directly linked to the deployment of v4.7.

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of v4.7 was followed by a deployment of v5.11, which may have caused the error.
why_chain: v4.7 deployment followed by v5.11 deployment.
v5.11 deployment may have introduced a conflict or dependency issue.
The error rate increase could be a result of the v5.11 deployment.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden increase in request volume.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume stayed about the same before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a change in latency.
ruled_out.reason: p95 latency stayed about the same before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: No configuration change was noted in the evidence.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region us-east rose from 0.45% to 2.49% (+453%), with a change point at 2026-03-03T09:50:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region us-east: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.13).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (727 per 5 min before, 904 per 5 min after, +24%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (121 ms before, 120 ms after, -1%).
Deployed catalog v4.7 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 2 min before the change; record R013)
High error rate on catalog in us-east (catalog, us-east; 10 min after the change; record R014)
Deployed catalog v5.11 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 212 min before the change; record R012)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.7) (catalog, us-east; 21 min after the change; record R015)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.7) (catalog, us-east; 26 min after the change; record R016)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the v4.7 deployment to prevent further error rate increase.
Monitor the system for any issues related to v5.11 deployment and take appropriate action if necessary.
Review the RequestHandler.serialize method in v4.7 to identify and fix the NullPointerException.
